title: Lunch Smoky Capsicum and Cheese Panini
subtitle: Midday Mega-Saver!
description: Down tools and drool… it’s lunch time! Whether in the staff room at work or al desko at home, eating a yummy lunch is key to work-life happiness. So make your lunch smarter, quicker and way more affordable with our tasty recipes.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the sandwich press (see Kitchen hacks). Cut the capsicum into 1.5cm-thick strips. Halve the buns.
Soften capsicum: Put the capsicum and 1 tbs water in a microwave-safe dish (see Kitchen hacks), cover and microwave for 5 mins or until softened.
Assemble panini: Spread the bun bases and tops with the barbecue sauce. Layer with the cheese, capsicum and one-third of the spinach. Sandwich with the bun tops.
Cook panini: Put the panini in the sandwich press, close and cook for 2-3 mins until golden and the cheese is melted. Cut the panini in half.

Make salad and serve up: Meanwhile, combine a drizzle of olive oil and a drizzle of white wine vinegar in a large bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Add the sunflower seeds and remaining spinach and toss to coat. Divide the panini among plates and serve with the spinach salad. Enjoy!

Kitchen hacks: Don't have a sandwich press? Put the assembled panini on an oven tray and bake in a 200C oven for 8-10 mins until golden and the cheese is melted. ~ Don't have a microwave? You can cook the capsicum on the sandwich press or in a frypan, turning occasionally, for 3-4 mins until charred.
